set u2=I2U(GetStoredInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i],"2"))

call StoreInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i],I2S(j),0)
call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ(udg_ab[i],u1)
call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ(udg_ab[i],u2)
call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ(udg_ab[i],u3)
call DestroyLightning(I2L(GetStoredInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i]+"_lightning","0")))
call StoreInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i]+"_lightning","0",0)
call DestroyLightning(I2L(GetStoredInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i]+"_lightning","1")))
call StoreInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i]+"_lightning","1",0)
call DestroyLightning(I2L(GetStoredInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i]+"_lightning","2")))
call StoreInteger(udg_GC,udg_sp[pid]+"_"+udg_stz[i]+"_lightning","2",0)
set u=null
set u1=null
set u2=null
set u3=null
return
endif
set j=j+1
endloop
set i=i+1
endloop
